patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I got really overwhelmed during finals and suddenly couldn't breathe right — I'm breathing super fast, my hands and lips are tingling and cramping up. It's terrifying but there's no chest pain.
clinical.presentationShort: 22yo F — acute hyperventilation with perioral/carpopedal tingling in the setting of stress, clear lungs, normal SpO2 — anxiety-driven.
clinical.presentationLong: 22-year-old female with acute hyperventilation and perioral and carpopedal paresthesias during exam stress, with clear lungs and a normal oxygen saturation — hyperventilation syndrome (diagnosis of exclusion).

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → reassurance, coached slow breathing, exclude organic causes; discharge. (A diagnosis of exclusion — SpO2 is normal here.)
diagnosis.why: Fast breathing + tingling hands/lips + NORMAL SpO2 + clear lungs = hyperventilation. Coach breathing — but exclude PE/asthma/DKA first.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, hands held up cramped, breathing fast
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 22-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: hands held up with fingers cramped, breathing fast. Expression: frightened and overwhelmed. Clearly visible: hands held up with cramped fingers and rapid breathing. No text, no logos.
